ask: Go 1.22. pipeline.go: channel pipeline — generator, fan-out to N transformers, fan-in with WaitGroup, context cancellation propagated to every stage, bounded buffers, error channel with errgroup-free collection, and a main that runs it with a timeout. write the file.
prose:
File written. The pipeline has all the pieces you asked for:

- `generator` emits `[0, n)` onto a buffered channel, exits on `ctx.Done()`
- `fanOut` launches N `transformer` goroutines reading from the shared input channel, with a `sync.WaitGroup` closing the merged results channel once all workers exit
- `fanIn` splits results into separate value and error channels, both buffered
- `collectErrors` drains the error channel without any errgroup dependency
- `main` runs it under a 3-second `context.WithTimeout`, drains values, waits on error collection, then prints outcome plus the error list

Run it with:

```
go run pipeline.go
```

The `work` function sleeps 1-5ms and fails ~10% of the time so you can see both the happy path and the error channel in action. Tweak `itemCount`, `workers`, `bufSize`, and `timeoutSec` at the top of `main` to watch the timeout path kick in.
